FFTRadNet.notes: Per-frame input tensor is 32*512*256 = channels*range*Doppler. 32 channels = real+imag of the 16-Rx range-Doppler spectrum; 512 range bins are code-fixed; the 256 Doppler axis carries the 12*16 MIMO array (192 virtual antennas) that fftradnet.py's hardcoded geometry (NbTxAntenna/NbRxAntenna) expects. RADIal-only; not configurable here.

RODNet_CDC.notes: Fully convolutional; RA map H*W is dataset-determined (CRUW ~128*128). in_channels=2 = real+imag of one map.

RODNet_CDCv2.notes: v2 uses MNet (mnet_cfg=[4,32]); in_channels=4. H*W dataset-determined.

RECORD.notes: Fully convolutional; H*W dataset-determined (CARRADA RD 256*64, RA 256*256). Temporal model (bottleneck LSTM).

RECORDNoLstmMulti.notes: CARRADA path uses in_channels=1 per feature; the CRUW stacked path uses in_channels=96. H*W dataset-determined. CONFIRM which applies to your setup.

MVRECORD.notes: Multi-view: separate RD/RA/AD encoders (in_channels=1 each). H*W dataset-determined.

RADDet.notes: RAD cube: range 256 * azimuth 256 * doppler 64; doppler bins are the channel dim (input_channels=64). Pinned in model config.

DAROD.notes: RD map 256*64, 1 channel (model config input_size=[256,64,1]). Pinned in model config.

RAMP_CNN.notes: ramap_rsize=128, ramap_asize=128 over a 16-frame window; consumes RD/RA/AD. in_channels not declared in model config (CONFIRM).

RadarCrossAttention.notes: Cross-attention over RD/RA/AD; no spatial size or in_channels pinned in model config (CONFIRM).
